# Dawn Maley — C-Suite Executive Operations & Fractional OBM (dawn.webintelagent.com)

> Senior C-Suite Executive Operations Partner and Fractional Online Business Manager (OBM) across entertainment, gaming, and tech.

## Core Tracks
- **Fractional OBM & Executive Defense:** Calendar Defense, Inbox Triage Architecture, and Cross-Functional Studio Logistics for creative agencies, game studios, and founders.
- **Full-Time C-Suite Executive Operations Partner:** Proven leadership office command at Sony Interactive Entertainment (PlayStation), Crunchyroll, and Trailer Park Group.

## Retainer Tiers
- **90-Min Executive Ops Audit ($495 One-Time):** Live Calendar Defense & Inbox Triage Architecture teardown + 30-Day Executive Bandwidth Recovery blueprint.
- **Executive Defense Retainer ($3,600 / mo — 40 hrs/mo):** Dedicated C-suite shield, daily command briefs, active Calendar Defense, and global travel logistics.
- **Fractional OBM & Studio Command ($6,800 / mo — 80 hrs/mo):** End-to-end Online Business Manager partnership, Cross-Functional Studio Logistics, vendor onboarding, and SOP library creation.
